name: EmojiGuide.org · ❤️ Red Heart Emoji

title.zh: EmojiGuide.org · 查任意表情的含义、长相

description.zh: Red Heart详情实见符号、码点、HTML表格与多平台红心图。 EmojiGuide.org 是一个按 Unicode 标准整理的表情目录站，提供每个表情的含义说明、跨平台图片及码点、符号与 HTML 等代码，可搜索浏览与复制。
description.en: EmojiGuide.org is a searchable emoji directory organized by Unicode, offering meanings, cross-platform pictures, and codepoints, symbols and HTML codes for each emoji for browsing and copying.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by EmojiGuide.org (https://emojiguide.org/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: Red Heart详情实见符号、码点、HTML表格与多平台红心图。

Visual details from source observation: 我们从首页的分类卡往下看，动物、食物、活动等题材都带小图和名称，查找时不必只记英文。Red Heart 详情页把红心符号、码点和 HTML 实体放在顶部，下方有不同平台的渲染图，方便写文案或做页面时对照长相、取用字符代码。站内说明仍标注 Unicode 15.0 与 Emoji 15.0，查较新的表情时要留意版本。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
